title: Tasks and Project Management Blocks
summary: 28 new project management blocks covering kanban boards, task lists, task detail views, project overviews and sprint ceremonies, with a new project-management page plan for the MCP server.
body:
Added a set of project management blocks, available under **Blocks** in five new docs pages: Tasks - Board, Task List, Task Detail, Project Overview and Sprint. The boards use the Draggable component with a shared group, everything keeps its own state and uses fictional sample data, and drag and drop always has a keyboard alternative.

#### Board

- A classic kanban board with an inline add and a move menu, swimlanes, a compact scrolling board, collapsible columns, work in progress limits that refuse drops and a board with search and filters

#### Task list

- Tasks grouped by project, a simple checklist with filters and inline editing, a sortable task table, due date sections with snooze, a reorderable backlog and tasks with expandable subtasks

#### Task detail

- A side sheet, a full page with click to edit, comments and activity tabs, subtasks with attachments, a properties sidebar with popover pickers and a quick add dialog

#### Project overview

- A header with key stats, progress cards, team workload bars, a milestone timeline, a searchable project grid with favorites and a sortable portfolio table

#### Sprint

- Sprint planning with a capacity meter, a burndown chart drawn in plain SVG with a text alternative, a sprint review with velocity and a retrospective board with limited votes

#### MCP

- New `project-management` page plan, also picked up by `plan-app`
- Block docs links and search keywords cover the five new categories
